     <strong>Update Order Status</strong>

### Update Order Status

| Use Case Name | Update Order Status |
| ------------ | ----- |    
| Summary: | The vendor changes the status of the order based on the order's readiness. |
| Actors: | Vendor |
| Preconditions: | An order request has been accepted by the vendor. |
| Postconditions: | The order status is changed.
| Basic Flow | **Actor Action** |
|            | 1. Vendor navigates to the order page using the "Order" tab. |
|            | 2. Vendor presses the "Running Orders" tab. |
|            | 3. Vendor clicks the action menu icon. |
|            | 4. Vendor selects a status. |               
|            | **System Action** | 
|            | 1.1 The system navigates to the order page.|
|            | 3.1 The system displays the list of statuses that can be used.|
|            | 4.1 The system updates the order status based on what was chosen. |
|           | |
